summary: Artisan Partners Asset Management filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 furnishing a press release reporting preliminary assets under management of $183.5 billion as of August 31, 2026, split between $94.5 billion in Artisan Funds/Global Funds and $89.0 billion in separate accounts. The filing disclosed that a long-standing sub-advisory client is diversifying its mandate to a three-manager structure; Artisan remains a manager but expects roughly $6 billion to rebalance out of the Global Value strategy in September 2026, with revenue impact smaller than the AUM reduction given the fee structure. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are stated; there is no risk-arb angle as this is an ordinary monthly AUM disclosure, not a special situation.
